WAVE 3A / P-1 (DEF-007) — CORRECTED IN PLACE, not removed. This was the Select option label on the discount-code kind picker. It instructed the admin to TYPE a fraction ("0.10 = 10%"), which is exactly the convention the owner's 2026-08-09 ruling reversed for the input side: storage stays FRACTIONAL, but ADMIN INPUT is percent-as-written (type 100, store 1.0). The amount field beside this label now takes percent-as-written and converts to the stored fraction (client/src/lib/percentDisplay.ts parsePercentInputToFraction), so leaving the old label in place would have told the admin to type 0.10 into a field that reads it as 0.1% — a 100x under-charge. Replaced by "Percent (type 10 for 10%)" plus an explicit on-screen convention note (data-testid=discount-percent-convention). No control, option or capability was removed: all three discount kinds are still selectable.

SC-2 — panel rendered INERT (code retained, nothing deleted). This form posts to the PLURAL ledger POST /api/partner/me/spvs/:id/distributions (spvFundStore -> spv_distributions) while the canonical engine writes the SINGULAR spv_distribution. One letter apart; the singular query cannot read the plural write. SC-2 adds an inbound link to this page, which would have made that split ledger reachable. Owner ruled the singular table canonical. Re-enable once SC-3 lands distribution_type on the canonical table and the form is repointed. This is that panel's submit handler.

MODIFICATION, NOT A REMOVAL. The refund Button, its data-testid (button-refund-invoice-<id>), its disabled logic, its label and its refund.mutate call are all still present and unchanged. ONE LINE INSIDE the onClick changed: the confirmation dialog rendered the amount by dividing minor units by 100, which UNDERSTATES A JPY REFUND BY 100x (JPY is ISO-4217 exponent 0). It now calls formatMinor(inv.amountMinor, inv.currency). This is the confirm dialog on a screen whose own copy reads 'This moves real money and cannot be undone' - the admin was shown the wrong figure before authorising a refund. PROOF OF NON-REMOVAL: reverting that single line restores 'no silent drops' with nothing else changed (Wave 21 ran this revert-and-restore). ROOT CAUSE: the guard fingerprints handlers by EXPRESSION HASH, so any edit to a handler body is indistinguishable from deleting it - the same fingerprinting weakness Wave 11 fixed for CHILD MEMBERSHIP (adding a tab read as removing the tab list) and that blocked Wave 4B from adding a roster column. The expression case is still unfixed and is logged as a guard follow-up. Allowlisting this one entry beats shipping a known 100x money-display defect on a refund dialog.

The surviving baseline sibling entry for the same path is therefore now SATISFIED by real JSX; only the redirect stub signature disappears.
